verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents its own controls for limiting request logging. The `cf-aig-collect-log` header overrides the gateway's default log setting, and `cf-aig-collect-log-payload` stops raw prompt and completion bodies from being stored. However, the docs frame payload opt-out as keeping usage metrics and request metadata visible, so there is no evidence that usage metrics or analytics collection can be turned off entirely. Missing for 10: a documented opt-out from usage metrics and analytics tracking, an account-wide telemetry opt-out, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: The \`cf-aig-collect-log\` header allows you to bypass the default log setting for the gateway.
The `cf-aig-collect-log-payload` header allows you to control whether the raw request and response bodies (payloads) are stored for a given request.
This is useful when you want to maintain visibility into usage metrics and request metadata without persisting sensitive prompt or completion data.
